question: is exchange-rateapi.com a separate service or an alias of AllRatesToday, and should its record be marked a duplicate or the same offer?
why: The pricing URL of exchange-rateapi.com redirects to allratestoday.com and the sign-up page is the same, but its terms page names a service called Exchange Rate API with its own contact address. A same_offer_as relation from data-apis/exchange-rateapi to data-apis/allratestoday is proposed here for the reviewer to decide.
